items: A law rune, an enchanted gem and some molten glass OR 10k gp
rec: A spiny helmet or slayer helm
rewards: Access to the White Knight's Armory

st.t: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.
s: Do you have any jobs for me yet?

st.t: Go to the second floor of the White Knights' Castle. Tell Sir Amik Varze you wish to join the White Knights, BUT refuse to be a Squire.
Return to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.
Go back to Sir Amik Varze on the second floor of the White Knights' Castle.
Report back to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.

Get a Commorb from Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park. Choose "Buy One" if you're paying 10,000 coins, or "Have One Made" if you brought a law rune, an enchanted gem and some molten glass. Then choose "YES".
Long-press the Commorb and choose Contact to contact Savant.

i: A law rune, an enchanted gem and some molten glass OR 10k gp

st.t: Enter Taverley Dungeon and follow it north, then east, then south to the Black Knights' Base. Talk to Lord Daquarius in its south-westernmost room.
Kill a Black Knight near Daquarius.
Talk to Lord Daquarius in Taverley Dungeon again.
If you haven't started the Enter the Abyss miniquest, first talk to the Mage of Zamorak in the Wilderness just north of Edgeville. Then talk to the Mage of Zamorak in south east Varrock.
Bring the 20 rune or pure essence to the Mage of Zamorak in Varrock.
Go to Canifis, and scan with your Commorb there until you find Solus.

Hunt down Solus Dellagar across Gielinor. Long-press the Commorb and choose Scan. Savant describes an item: go to the place it points to and scan there. Repeat until you are given 20 noted pure essence, about 7 places in all. At the fourth place Solus hits you hard and you're sent to Falador. At the sixth a level 32 Black Knight attacks, and you don't have to kill it.

What Savant describes, and where to scan. Cloak: Rellekka. Banana: Musa Point plantation. Wizard hat: Wizards' Tower, ground floor library. Very strange weapon: Dorgesh-Kaan mine, through the Lumbridge Castle cellar (bring a light source). Fur or cake: Ardougne Market. Cape: inside the Champions' Guild. Ticket: Castle Wars. Hat: Grand Tree, next to King Narnode. Ear muffs: Slayer Tower. Eye patch: Brimhaven pub. Fake beard: Ali Morrisane's stall in Al Kharid. Big frog legs: end of the Lumbridge Swamp Caves (bring a light source, a spiny helmet and, if it's your first time in, a rope). Goblin armour: Goblin Village. Beer: Dragon Inn in Yanille. Worm: McGrubor's Wood. Toy horse: Draynor Village, near Diango. Unholy symbol: Shrine of Scorpius, north of the Observatory.

i: A spiny helmet or slayer helm

st.t: Go to the Rune Essence mine by talking to any of the NPCs that can teleport you there.
Only if you don't have Solus' hat: use the 'contact' option on the Commorb to get it from Savant. You need one free inventory slot.
Show Solus' hat to Sir Amik Varze on the second floor of the White Knights' Castle in Falador.
